project_metadata.question_text: What feature or aspect of our mobile app would you most like to see improved?

topics.label: Performance and Speed
examples: App is too slow and crashes frequently
Loading times are unbearable, especially for images
Performance needs major improvement - very laggy
App freezes constantly, very frustrating experience
Speed optimization should be the top priority

topics.label: User Interface and Design
examples: Interface is confusing and not intuitive
Design looks outdated compared to competitors
Navigation could be much simpler and cleaner
Too many buttons and options cluttering the screen
Modern redesign would greatly improve user experience

topics.label: Search and Discovery
examples: Search function doesn't work properly
Can't find what I'm looking for easily
Search results are often irrelevant or incomplete
Need better filtering and sorting options
Discovery features are poorly implemented

topics.label: Notifications and Alerts
examples: Too many unnecessary notifications
Notification settings are hard to customize
Important alerts get buried in spam notifications
Better control over what notifications I receive
Notification timing could be improved

topics.label: Account and Profile Management
examples: Profile editing is limited and clunky
Account settings are buried too deep in menus
More customization options for user profiles
Easier way to manage account preferences
Profile sync across devices needs improvement

topics.label: Offline Functionality
examples: Need better offline mode capabilities
App doesn't work at all without internet connection
Offline content should be accessible
Download feature for offline use would be great
Basic functionality should work without data connection

topics.label: Security and Privacy
examples: More transparency about data usage
Better privacy controls and settings
Two-factor authentication would be appreciated
Security features are good but could be enhanced
Clear data deletion options needed

topics.label: Integration with Other Apps
examples: Better integration with social media platforms
Calendar sync would be very useful
More third-party app connections
Integration features work well but need expansion
Cross-platform compatibility improvements

topics.label: Content Management
examples: Better organization tools for saved content
Content categorization needs improvement
Easier content sharing and export options
More storage space for user content
Content backup and restore functionality

topics.label: Customer Support Integration
examples: In-app help and support is hard to find
Need better customer service chat integration
Help documentation within the app is limited
Easier way to report bugs and issues
FAQ section could be more comprehensive

topics.label: Accessibility Features
examples: Better support for screen readers
Font size options are appreciated but need expansion
High contrast mode would be helpful
Voice control features would be great
Accessibility features are good but could be enhanced

topics.label: Battery and Resource Usage
examples: App drains battery too quickly
High memory usage causes phone to slow down
Background activity should be more efficient
Resource optimization needs major work
App makes my phone overheat during use

topics.label: Customization Options
examples: More theme and color options
Customizable dashboard layout
Personalization features are limited
Widget customization would be great
Let users choose their preferred layout

topics.label: Updates and New Features
examples: Updates are too frequent and disruptive
New features often break existing functionality
More communication about upcoming changes
Feature updates are generally positive
Beta testing program for new features would be nice

topics.label: Cross-Platform Sync
examples: Sync between phone and tablet doesn't work well
Cross-device functionality needs improvement
Settings don't carry over between platforms
Web version and mobile app should sync better
Cloud sync is unreliable

topics.label: Positive Feedback
examples: App works great overall, just minor improvements needed
Love the recent updates and new features
User experience has improved significantly
App is reliable and easy to use
Great job on the latest version

topics.label: Tutorial and Onboarding
examples: Onboarding process is confusing for new users
Need better tutorials for advanced features
Help guides are outdated and incomplete
Interactive tutorials would be helpful
First-time user experience needs improvement

topics.label: Data Management
examples: Better data export options needed
Data usage tracking would be useful
Easier way to clear app data and cache
Data compression for storage efficiency
More control over data retention policies

topics.label: Social Features
examples: Social sharing features could be expanded
Community features would add value
Better friend finding and connection tools
Social integration works well
Group functionality would be appreciated
